notices.summary: A sailing regatta race series is scheduled every Wednesday evening from April 29 to September 16, 2026, in Upper New York Harbor.
Shoaling has been reported in the vicinity of Great Kills Harbor, between buoys 6 and 8.
Shoaling has been identified in the Arthur Kill between Tremley Point Reach and Rahway River.
Structural repairs to the Brooklyn Bridge will reduce vertical clearance by 17 feet until June 30, 2026.
Rehabilitation work at the George Washington Bridge will reduce vertical clearance by 3ft 9in plus 2ft sag max starting May 1, 2024.
